def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The full-height 2 line is the barrier; the outer field is the background.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
    bg = grid[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    minc = min(c for _, c, _ in cells)
    maxc = max(c for _, c, _ in cells)
    if maxc < sep:  # slide toward the barrier from the left
        shift = sep - 1 - maxc
        marker = maxc
    else:  # slide toward the barrier from the right
        shift = sep + 1 - minc
        marker = maxc + shift + 1
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][sep] = 2
        out[r][marker] = 8
    for r, c, v in cells:
        nc = c + shift
        if 0 <= nc < w and nc != sep and nc != marker:
            out[r][nc] = v
    return out
